title: Uncertainty-Aware Role-Switching Debate: Improving Truthfulness in Large Language Models

contributions.purpose: 用结构化辩论提升 LLM 答案真实性
contributions.mechanism: 五阶段辩论协议:独立作答→交叉质证定位错误→中途角色互换→显式披露置信与不确定性→弱判官裁决
contributions.evaluation: OpenBookQA 测试集 74.3% 准确率(Gemini-2.5 辩手 + Gemini-2.0-lite 判官,零微调零外部知识)
contributions.domain: LLM 对齐 / 多智能体辩论
contributions.source_quote: We propose an Uncertainty-Aware Role-Switching Debate protocol to address these limitations.

contributions.purpose: 验证角色互换与不确定性两个新阶段的贡献
contributions.mechanism: 消融依次移除不确定性阶段、角色互换阶段、两者全移
contributions.source_quote: Ablation experiments confirm that both the role-switch and uncertainty-reporting phases significantly boost performance.

contributions.purpose: 揭示纯辩论无法弥补基模型知识缺口(负结果)
contributions.mechanism: 与检索/微调 SOTA 及人类水平对比
contributions.evaluation: 74.3% 远低于 UnifiedQA 87.2% 与人类 ~92%,仅略高于无检索 BERT 60.4%
contributions.source_quote: our accuracy remains far behind the state-of-the-art of ~87% and well below human-level performance (~92%).

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our Phase II (focused rebuttal) is inspired by that idea of zeroing in on specific points [8], but we generalize it to a more flexible dialogue instead of a rigid tree structure.
To our knowledge, no prior work on LLM debates has implemented a role-switching phase where agents swap perspectives, nor a dedicated uncertainty-quantification phase.

notes: 负结果明确:辩论法 74.3% 远低于检索/微调 SOTA(87.2%)与人类(92%),作者自述受基模型知识限制,并列 failure cases 章。无编号贡献列表,由 abstract+ablation 归纳。质量小瑕:消融正文把不确定性阶段误称 Phase V(方法部分定义为 Phase IV),编号错位;第一作者署名栏出现 'GPT-4o'(AI 共作/署名痕迹,该会议 AI 为主作者)。四元组适配良好。
